speaker.name: Sam Tripp
speaker.title: Lead Cloud Engineer, Made Tech
speaker.bio: Sam Tripp is a Lead Cloud Engineer at Made Tech, where he helps public sector teams build cloud services that are secure, maintainable and production-ready. With 15+ years in the industry his focus is cloud architecture and the practical uses of generative AI, favouring the applications that survive contact with real users rather than the demo.

talk.title: Pairing Internal Experiments with Public Sector Impact
talk.abstract: Building AI for the public sector requires agility, scale, and multi-cloud flexibility. In this lightning talk, Made Tech shares our AI evolution pairing internal R&D experiments with real-world client deployments. We’ll examine how serverless tooling across AWS, Azure, and GCP enabled us to pivot quickly and scale securely, highlighting key live public sector deployments. Rather than a deep dive into a single tool, this is a frank look at our architectural arc; what surprised us about running AI in serverless environments, what changed our minds, and what we’d build differently today.
